title: Fourier batch linear coefficient
statement: For each natural number $k$, let $D_k$ be the low degree junta cutoff and let $C_k$ be the linear confidence coefficient. The Fourier batch linear coefficient is $(D_k+1)(36\cdot 4^k\cdot C_k)$.
